result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign or SignWell**\. They offer the essential features without the complexity and expense of enterprise-level platforms.

However, the best choice depends on how many contracts you send, how many employees need access, and whether you need more than just signatures.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

Here are my top five picks for 2026.

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simple business signing)

Starting around \$15/month, annual billing

- Easy to send and collect signatures.
- Unlimited signature requests on paid plans.
- Templates and signing reminders.
- Good Dropbox integration.

Best if you regularly send contracts, agreements, and customer paperwork.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. SignWell**

(Best value for small businesses)

Around \$10/month billed annually

- Very easy to use.
- Reusable document templates.
- Automatic reminders.
- Free plan for up to three documents per month.

Best if you want affordable, straightforward e-signatures.

[Visit SignWell](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

Starting around \$19/user/month, annual billing

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Collect electronic signatures.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Payment and CRM integrations.

Best if you send sales proposals, estimates, and customer contracts.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. DocuSign**

Starting around \$11/month, annual billing

- Widely recognized by customers.
- Strong document tracking.
- Extensive business integrations.
- Advanced signing workflows.

Best if you work with lots of outside companies and clients.

[Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Logo Wordmark PNG Vector - BrandLogo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/95na-wLQUN9p7GmfVbVlsMH9WIm3-bHOmsuOzR4w7FH_LNHajHgaUKajbYSFfuQalq9gsQjPtmcFPYYjJQoXKBtI8uyMeQC8oBjmdwkaHvf0cQn2ZgYIR22CA9JGfELZMa-MGbcgzYfhWePcbsbIj2Mlr0RTRu05Ww7rIP3mtZmaOkamqppjBubOBDVYwJ7W?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

Starting around \$16.99/month for relevant Acrobat plans

- Excellent PDF functionality.
- Edit, prepare, and sign documents.
- Strong document management.
- Useful if you already use Adobe Acrobat.

Best if your business works with PDFs all day.

[Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-sign.html)

Pricing is approximate and varies by plan, billing frequency, and number of users. ## What I'd look for before buying

Make sure the software includes\:

- Legally recognized electronic signatures.
- A downloadable signed PDF.
- An audit trail showing who signed and when.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Automatic signing reminders.
- Multiple employees or users if needed.

For U.S. businesses, check compatibility with the federal ESIGN Act and applicable state UETA requirements.

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your business.

I have three quick questions\:

**1\. What type of business do you operate?**

search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
